decisions.reason: As a close-to-core printer that already survived its first review, has its own web presence, and supports the firm's broader identification portfolio, management is likely to stay committed absent clear failure signals.

This flagship 2024 laser line is highly visible, central to the firm's announced Industry 4.0 direction, and backed by a multi-model launch, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal very unlikely.

The new compact laser marking cabin builds directly on the established laser business and received standalone promotion, so the firm is likely to continue backing it while the recent launch is given time to prove itself.

Although more niche and less prominently presented, the lubricant printing system extends the firm's application-led coding offer and its trade-fair award gives management a temporary justification to persist rather than retreat quickly.
